eloquent.linePrev: And then they went on to say
eloquent.line: That the pearly gates had some eloquent graffiti
eloquent.lineNext: Like "We'll meet again" and "Fuck the man"
stanza: I heard from someone you're still pretty
And then they went on to say
That the pearly gates had some eloquent graffiti
Like "We'll meet again" and "Fuck the man"
And "Tell my mother not to worry"
And angels with their great handshakes
Were always done in such a hurry
